svg.title: Chromalect v0.1 color identities: 40 components
svg.desc: Precision swatch reference: forty written components, each labeled with its own stable hex color. These are separate component swatches, not glyph-level colored compound characters.
svg.text: Pilot v0.1 · Standard Mandarin / Simplified Chinese · 40 component identities
